reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: Addressed a double-put bug in fuse_try_move_page() where the folio refcount drops to zero prematurely. Added an extra folio_get() before replace_page_cache_folio() to maintain the reference.

reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: Fixed a bug where the NFSv4 server was not properly handling delegated timestamps in certain scenarios, leading to incorrect timestamp updates. Added code to handle these cases correctly.
reviews.raw_body:
nfs4_open_delegation() refuses delegations for NFSv4.0 write opens on
CLAIM_NULL and CLAIM_FH, as its comment explains, but CLAIM_PREVIOUS
skips the check. An NFSv4.0 client reclaiming a write open during grace
can therefore get a write delegation, and a GETATTR it sends before
DELEGRETURN in the same compound can never be answered.

Apply the same check to CLAIM_PREVIOUS.

Fixes: 1d3dd1d56ce8 ("NFSD: Enable write delegation support")
Signed-off-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@kernel.org>
---
 fs/nfsd/nfs4state.c | 3 +++
 1 file changed, 3 insertions(+)

diff --git a/fs/nfsd/nfs4state.c b/fs/nfsd/nfs4state.c
index 490fefaef52a..64bf2e96dc7b 100644
--- a/fs/nfsd/nfs4state.c
+++ b/fs/nfsd/nfs4state.c
@@ -7532,6 +7532,9 @@ nfs4_open_delegation(struct svc_rqst *rqstp, struct nfsd4_open *open,
 	open->op_recall = false;
 	switch (open->op_claim_type) {
 		case NFS4_OPEN_CLAIM_PREVIOUS:
+			if (open->op_share_access & NFS4_SHARE_ACCESS_WRITE &&
+					!clp->cl_minorversion)
+				goto out_no_deleg;
 			if (!cb_up)
 				open->op_recall = true;
 			break;

--

reviews.author: Jeff Layton
reviews.summary: Addressed a bug where the NFSv4 server was granting read delegations with attributes when timestamps were requested, leading to incorrect behavior. Changed the delegation type to OPEN_DELEGATE_READ instead.
reviews.raw_body:
__nfsd_setattr() adds ATTR_CTIME only when ATTR_DELEG is clear, to keep a
delegated atime-only update from moving ctime. But ATTR_DELEG is set for
the whole iattr, so a holder's chmod or chown sent along with a delegated
atime changes the mode or owner without updating ctime.

Add ATTR_CTIME unless the request is a delegated atime-only update. A
delegated mtime whose ctime failed vetting now gets ctime = now instead
of no ctime update.

Fixes: f9a348e0de19 ("nfsd: don't set the ctime on delegated atime updates")
Signed-off-by: Jeff Layton <jlayton@kernel.org>
---
 fs/nfsd/vfs.c | 8 +++++---
 1 file changed, 5 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/fs/nfsd/vfs.c b/fs/nfsd/vfs.c
index 4f3e480a3981..c0d10c263a93 100644
--- a/fs/nfsd/vfs.c
+++ b/fs/nfsd/vfs.c
@@ -514,10 +514,12 @@ static int __nfsd_setattr(struct dentry *dentry, struct iattr *iap)
 	/*
 	 * If ATTR_DELEG is set, then this is an update from a client that
 	 * holds a delegation. If this is an update for only the atime, the
-	 * ctime should not be changed. If the update contains the mtime
-	 * too, then ATTR_CTIME should already be set.
+	 * ctime should not be changed. Any other attribute change, such as
+	 * a mode or owner change sent along with a delegated atime, must
+	 * update the ctime.
 	 */
-	if (!(iap->ia_valid & ATTR_DELEG))
+	if (!(iap->ia_valid & ATTR_DELEG) ||
+	    (iap->ia_valid & ~(ATTR_DELEG | ATTR_ATIME | ATTR_ATIME_SET)))
 		iap->ia_valid |= ATTR_CTIME;
 
 	return notify_change(&nop_mnt_idmap, dentry, iap, NULL);

--

2026-11-20.patch_summary: This patch series addresses various issues in the NFSv4 server's delegated timestamp support, including bugs and inconsistencies in how timestamps are updated and handled. The patches aim to improve the accuracy and reliability of timestamp updates, particularly in scenarios involving file copying, cloning, and delegation.
